book.title: Bayesian Adversarial Machine Learning
book.description: A Bayesian perspective on learning and decision making under adversarial uncertainty.
book.coverAlt: Two opposing AI robots with stars woven into their circuitry, facing one another across a probability landscape joined by a delicate orbit of golden stars.

chapters.summary: Robustness is assessed through the quality of the decisions a model supports. Utility gaps connect adversarial risk analysis, minimax protection and least-favorable attack distributions, leading to a pipeline for computing, monitoring and revising defenses.
